segments.name: web development platform
segments.description: Global cloud-based web development platform selling website creation, commerce and business tools through freemium subscriptions to self-creators, agencies and enterprises.
segments.evidence: As such, the Company has determined that it operates in one operating and reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Users pay subscription fees, free and premium, for web creation and business solutions on the platform, and partners also promote its services.
revenueModel.evidence: We offer our solutions through a freemium SaaS business model (free and premium services), and as of December 31, 2025, we had approximately 6.1 million premium subscriptions.
